name: diagram-layout
title: Diagram layout
description: Places a Diagram's nodes and routes its edges with ELK, in a Web Worker, measuring every part of every card first: top to bottom by default, labels on their routes, self-loops in room of their own. ELK is 442 KB gzipped and licensed EPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later, so it's only loaded when a layout's first asked for, and this item is what installs it.
